question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or replacement. Items must be in their original condition and packaging.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: You can track your order by clicking on the tracking link sent to your email or SMS, or by visiting 'My Orders' section on our app or website.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 business days depending on your location and pincode.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Once the returned item is inspected at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 5 to 7 business days to your original payment method.

question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
answer: You can cancel your order from the 'My Orders' section as long as it has not been packed or dispatched for shipping.

question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for most products and delivery locations. An additional nominal convenience fee may apply on checkout.

question: How can I change my delivery address?
answer: You can update your delivery address from 'My Orders' before the item is dispatched. Once dispatched, address changes are not permitted.

question: What should I do if I received a damaged or defective item?
answer: Please report damaged or defective products within 48 hours of delivery via 'My Orders' with unboxing photos or video, and we will initiate an immediate replacement.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Currently, we only ship across India to serviceable postal codes. International shipping is not supported at this moment.

question: How can I apply a discount coupon code?
answer: You can enter your promotional or discount coupon code in the 'Apply Coupon' field on the checkout page before completing payment.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, Wallets, and Cash on Delivery.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: Yes, clothing and footwear items can be exchanged for a different size or color within 14 days of delivery, subject to stock availability.

question: How do I schedule a return pickup?
answer: When initiating a return under 'My Orders', select 'Doorstep Pickup' and choose a convenient pickup date and time window.

question: Why was my order cancelled automatically?
answer: Orders may be automatically cancelled due to failed payment verification, sudden out-of-stock inventory, or unserviceable address issues.

question: How can I get an invoice for my purchase?
answer: You can download the GST tax invoice anytime from 'My Orders' by clicking 'Download Invoice' next to your completed order.

question: Are shipping charges refundable on return?
answer: Standard delivery and express shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to a damaged, defective, or incorrect product sent by us.

question: How do I redeem my store credits or loyalty points?
answer: Your reward coins and store credits appear automatically at checkout. Simply check the 'Use Store Credit' box before paying.

question: What is your warranty policy for electronics?
answer: All electronic products carry standard brand warranty ranging from 6 months to 2 years. Contact the authorized brand service center with your invoice.

question: What happens if I miss my delivery?
answer: Our courier partner will attempt delivery up to 3 times before returning the package to the sender. You will receive an SMS before each attempt.

question: Can someone else receive my package on my behalf?
answer: Yes, anyone at your delivery address can receive the package. For prepaid orders with an OTP, they will need to provide the delivery OTP sent to your phone.

question: How do I delete or deactivate my account?
answer: Go to 'Account Settings' -> 'Privacy & Security' -> 'Request Account Deletion'. All your active orders must be completed prior to deletion.

question: Do you offer No-Cost EMI?
answer: Yes, No-Cost EMI is available on select credit and debit cards for eligible orders above ₹3,000. Check the payment page for eligible banks.

question: Can I modify items in my order after placing it?
answer: Items within a confirmed order cannot be modified. If you wish to change items, please cancel the existing order and place a new one.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our 24/7 customer support via the in-app chat, email at support@store.com, or toll-free at 1800-123-4567.

question: Why is my payment deducted but order not placed?
answer: If money was deducted without an order confirmation, your bank will automatically reverse the transaction within 24 to 48 hours.

question: What is the return window for perishable or grocery items?
answer: Fresh food, groceries, and personal hygiene items are non-returnable due to safety and health reasons, unless received spoiled or expired.

question: Can I choose a specific delivery time slot?
answer: Time slot selection is available only for Grocery and Express Delivery orders in select metro cities at checkout.

question: How do I leave a product review?
answer: Visit 'My Orders', find the delivered item, and tap 'Write a Review' to share your rating, feedback, and photos.

question: What if an item is missing from my package?
answer: Sometimes items are shipped in separate packages. Check your order tracking for multiple tracking numbers, or contact support within 48 hours.

question: How do I buy or redeem a Gift Card?
answer: Purchase gift cards from the 'Gift Cards' section. To redeem, enter the 16-digit card code and PIN in your wallet or on the checkout page.
